title: mattstack zone marker (mattstack.jsonc)
description: Marks the top of a mattstack zone. A repo may hold many team zones (one per namespace) and at most one user zone; all team zones in a repo share one org.

namespace.description: team only: the plugin name users type as /<namespace>:<verb>

org.description: team only: the marketplace name; installs read <namespace>@<org>
